newsitem.title: USA: ADT Ltd adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: ADT Ltd adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: ADT Ltd said Monday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to block unsolicited takeover bids that do not offer an adequate price.

The plan would be triggered if an individual or group acquired 15 percent or more of ADT's common shares. ADT said the plan was not adopted in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company.
Under the plan, each common shareholder at the close of business November 15 will receive a distribution of one right for each common share held.
Each right would entitle the holder to purchase from ADT shares of a new series of first preference shares at an initial purchase price of $90 per 1/100th of a share.
